*Eleven people are killed after a [[Tank truck|fuel truck]] explosion on a [[highway]] near [[Kampala]], [[Uganda]]. [https://apnews.com/article/uganda-fuel-truck-explosion-ae9b329cbd20e0799fab949cf5e8aefe (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2024 McDonald's E. coli outbreak]]
**The [[U.S.]] [[Center for Disease Control]] announces that one person has died and at least 48 others have become ill in [[Escherichia coli|an ''E. coli'' outbreak]] linked to [[McDonald's]] [[Quarter Pounder]] [[hamburger|beef sandwiches]] in ten [[Western United States|western]] and [[Midwestern United States|midwest states]] with the first case confirmed on 27 September. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c33v3klkdy8o (BBC News)]

**[[Foreign interference in the 2024 United States elections]]
***The [[Donald Trump 2024 presidential campaign|presidential campaign]] of former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] files a formal complaint to the [[Federal Election Commission]] against the [[United Kingdom]]'s [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]], accusing the Labour Party of "blatant foreign interference" in the election to support the [[Kamala Harris 2024 presidential campaign|Kamala Harris presidential campaign]].
